## Samsung Secures More Than $200 Billion AI Chip Deal with Broadcom Through 2030

A multi-year commitment of this scale by Broadcom to Samsung is a meaningful competitive signal for TSMC's foundry dominance thesis; TSM holders should assess share and margin implications while AVGO holders gain a supply-chain diversification data point.

- Samsung has won an AI chip manufacturing deal with Broadcom valued at more than $200 billion, running through 2030.
- Headlines across three outlets frame this as a direct foundry challenge to TSMC.
- The deal positions Samsung as a major long-term AI capex beneficiary alongside Broadcom.
- Consistent figures across outlets support high classifier confidence.
